sources.name: Raissi, Perdikaris & Karniadakis (2017), Physics Informed Deep Learning, Part I
sources.text: Primary paper. Continuous-time Burgers implementation: section 2.1, equations 3–4. The paper also studies other PDEs and discrete-time models; those are not implemented in this lesson.

sources.name: Authors’ explanation and original code
sources.text: Original equations, boundary/initial data and TensorFlow formulation. This lesson independently reimplements a small CPU version in PyTorch.

sources.name: PyTorch: torch.autograd.grad
sources.text: Official differentiation API. create_graph preserves the coordinate derivatives needed by the residual and training gradients.

sources.name: Executed CPU experiment and reference checks
sources.text: Seed 11, float64, four CPU threads, 1297 parameters, 384 collocation points, t in [0,0.2]. Independent Cole-Hopf quadrature and separate validation points. Not an original-paper accuracy reproduction.
